items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Sonny Greer set up on the bandstand

ctx.x: been there that night, you would've heard some music you never heard before in your life. Those two bands really went after each other. They wasn't playing, because -- what's he drummer with Duke at that time? Sonny Greer? Sonny Greer.

When Duke set up, Sonny had his -- Sonny Greer set up on the bandstand and we was over there, and we just got through with a number. And Sonny was setting up his drums and tympanis tuning up his things. He had this (inaudible) and his chimes around him. And Chick looked over at him and said, "What is he tuning up for? I'm gonna kill him before he get started." And he did. He say, "What's he tuning up for?" And Sonny -- you know, how Sonny was, Sonny was nice (inaudible). Oh Sonny was just going, man. Just tuning…
